name: pumba-iptables-rule-counter-sampling
instr:
Pumba cannot sample live packet and byte counters for the exact iptables rule active during a loss action. Add sampling across Docker, containerd, and Podman without changing unsampled loss behavior.

Keep rule identity immutable across copies and slice changes so application, samples, reporting, and paired cleanup correlate uniquely. Docker, containerd, and privileged Podman queries must preserve target, sidecar, pull, namespace, cancellation, and rule semantics, with equivalent output producing identical normalized unsigned counters. Reject rootless Podman sampling before delegation. Malformed, negative, overflowing, and execution results must fail without fabricated samples.

Sessions must emit requested ordinals in order, stop on completion or cancellation, retain completed work and target-specific failures, and return empty success when no query is needed. Cancellation or one target failure must prevent later queries while reporting every successful and failed target.

Through `iptables.NewLossCommand` and `cmd.NewLossCLICommand`, sampled loss must apply one identified rule, sample only while active, then perform bounded paired cleanup even after failure. Report samples, summaries, and failures deterministically under the requested controls. Docker must delete the same rule it applied. Rootless Podman must retain its identified failure while cleanup removes the active rule. Containerd sidecar observations must reach the common session and formatter without runtime-specif
